description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Odo', which implements a 2D odometer (speedometer) chart as part of the Image_Graph plotting package. It includes methods for setting chart parameters, drawing the odometer, ranges, axes, arrows, and markers, and handles rendering details specific to odometer visualizations.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Odo
classes.description: Class for rendering odometer (speedometer) style plots, with configurable range, markers, and visual styles.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Odo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the odometer plot with a dataset and computes min/max values.

methods.name: setCenter
methods.description: Sets the center coordinates of the odometer circle.

methods.name: _value2angle
methods.description: Converts a data value to an angle position on the odometer.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Prepares internal parameters such as radius and center based on plot dimensions.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Sets the start and end values of the odometer range.

methods.name: setAngles
methods.description: Defines the start angle and span (width) of the odometer arc.

methods.name: setRadiusWidth
methods.description: Sets the radius percentage for the plot's width.

methods.name: setArrowSize
methods.description: Configures the size of the arrow marker in length and width.

methods.name: setArrowMarker
methods.description: Assigns a marker object for arrow visualization.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Handles final rendering steps, including initialization and drawing components.

methods.name: setTickLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the tick marks on the odometer.

methods.name: setAxisTicks
methods.description: Defines how many small ticks appear between major tick marks.

methods.name: _drawAxis
methods.description: Draws the odometer arc outline and tick marks.

methods.name: setArrowLineStyle
methods.description: Sets the visual style for arrow lines.

methods.name: setArrowFillStyle
methods.description: Sets the fill style for arrow markers.

methods.name: _drawArrow
methods.description: Renders arrow markers on the plot.

methods.name: _getMarkerData
methods.description: Calculates positional data for markers based on a point and plot configuration.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws markers for arrow points on the canvas.

methods.name: addRangeMarker
methods.description: Adds a range segment to the odometer with specific min and max values.

methods.name: setRangeMarkerFillStyle
methods.description: Sets fill styles for range segments.

methods.name: _drawRange
methods.description: Renders range segments on the odometer as slices.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the plot for the legend.

methods.name: _legendSample
methods.description: Prepares and renders a legend sample using the plot's visual style.
